newsitem.title: USA: MainStreet agrees to buy Tysons.
newsitem.headline: MainStreet agrees to buy Tysons.

text.p: MainStreet BankGroup Inc said on Friday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tysons Financial Corp for stock.
The deal values Tysons shares at $14.50 apiece, MainStreet said in a news release. Tysons shares closed at 14 in Nasdaq trading, unchanged on the day.
MainStreet shares closed down 3/8 to 27-5/8, also in Nasdaq trading.
Tysons has assets of $86.2 million and four locations in the Northern Virginia and greater Washington region.
The deal remains subject to approval by regulators and Tysons shareholders.
MainStreet has total assets of $1.4 billion.
